Fixture for issue #10 (defect 1): entry points that exist by CONVENTION.

A workspace monorepo whose HTTP surface a line-content scan cannot see —
handlers that never spell out `req.query`, spread over four ecosystems and
three workspace packages. Every `pages/api`, `app/api`, controller, web-root
PHP script and serverless handler here must show up as an `http` entry point,
and each workspace package must be its own `investigate` region.
